lines: Give the sun to a frozen heart.
And I am that position for you.
I was nursing a rather arrogant delusion.
I'm sorry (I'm sorry).
Smile (smile) and go.
A positivity so intense it could burn.
I realized its coldness and cruelty.
What I truly want to give you is something both chilling and hot.
It's not a pretty lie, but it's beautiful and unshakable.
It warms the deepest part of the chest, beyond the surface.
I have ideals, yet wherever I search my heart, I cannot find them.
It's as if they simply aren't there.
I want to convey, but it won't reach.
That absurdity now
binds me tightly.
My cowardly
every gesture and step
words are like snowflakes
even if I wanted to give them to you
the more I become obsessed
the more the shape crumbles, falls and melts away
and disappears, though
the words I choose
the feelings entrusted there
I can't give up on making your heart tremble.
More than saying I love you, until love reaches you
just wait a little longer.
Even standing beside you in thin clothes
I end up sweating unnecessarily, me.
No matter what, I'm lukewarm and will end up hurting you.
"Isn't the heart cold when the palm feels hot?"
Don't say such cruel things even as a joke.
I could say it differently, but
Even if I wager my whole life, please overturn it properly.
To save is to be saved.
This equation now
gently peels away.
Sturdy theoretical armor
excessive packaging of pride
I want kindness more than correctness.
And the one who can receive it
is like an illumination
not a crowd, but just one person
who is you.
Trying to mend the cracked fissure with the words I spoke
the curtain pulled back by too much heat
such failures
layer upon layer, again and again
I want to find them someday
the ultimate perfect phrase
words are like snowflakes
as if I presented them to you
When time passes, usually
they overflow from memory, fall and melt
but it still disappears.
ever attached to our story
like subtitles
when we look back
when we glance unexpectedly
I want to keep searching for what makes your heart tremble
More than saying I love you, until love reaches you
just wait a little longer.
to the point where I don't even want any words
even on a night frozen by sorrow
I am by your side of my own accord
thinking about this and that
the snow may melt, but it remains
